name: Meran
source:
From: Mobile Suit Gundam Char's Counterattack
Executive officer of the Ra Cailum, Rank: Commander. He had a calm and collected disposition, and at the time of the Second Neo Zeon War. he was carrying out a supporting role for Captain Bright.
